text:
anya: quick report from yesterday's staging runs: onboarding Zephyr-v1 q5->q8 shows a detokenize/regression around CJK numeric ranges (dates).
sam: ugh ok drop the tiny repro please?
anya: minimal repro below. float32 good, q8 bad.
li: ```
src: 我们将在2024-02-01至2024-02-10进行迁移。
ref: We will migrate between 2024-02-01 and 2024-02-10.
zephyr-q8: We will migrate from 2024 年 2 月 1 日 to 2024 年 2 月 10 日 2024.
zephyr-fp32: We will migrate between 2024-02-01 and 2024-02-10.
```
anya: note extra year token and spacing in q8 english output, causing BLEU drop (~5.8) on date-heavy slice.
maria: could be tokenizer boundary flip around the hyphen/ndash. can we dump subtokens and detok spans?
anya: tok dump (zephyr token ids): `[CLS] 我 们 将 在 2024 - 02 - 01 至 2024 - 02 - 10 进 行 迁 移 。 [SEP]`
sam: hyphens are split as separate tokens -> detok might insert spaces when joining. fp32 logits probably favored different boundary so detok merged correctly.
li: any runtime differences? kv-cache, fallback, reflow? those can touch prefix merging.
anya: runtime logs show a `reflow_aligned=true` path on q8 for these requests; not present on fp32.
infra-bot: build-4521 (q8) uses kernel-set v2.5.1, math-kernel tiling changed.
maria: that aligns with hypothesis: kernel numerical shifts nudged subtoken probs and changed merge decisions.
sam: short-term: let's add a post-detok normalizer for date ranges (regex based) in the translation path for staging/prod canary to avoid user-facing dupes. not great but fast.
li: add the date-range slice to the nightly regression suite and fail q8 canary until bisect completes.
anya: starting bisect to pin the kernel commit/tiling change. I'll also run a tokenizer roundtrip shadow test across many numeric formats (YYYY MM DD, with different dash chars).
ci-bot: ci:trigger job shadow-roundtrip-dates --models zephyr-fp32,zephyr-q8 --slice date_numeric_variants --env staging
maria: also check multi-locale: chinese numeric forms, japanese era dates, and digit grouping with commas. could be broader than just yyyy-mm-dd.
sam: good call. if detok threshold is marginal, other numeric contexts will flip too.
li: once bisect identifies the kernel id, infra please test a build with the older matmul/tile to confirm regression goes away. @infra-bot
infra-bot: acknowledged. will try a revert-build test and post kernel ids.
anya: blocking q8 rollout for now. will post bisect result and proposed regex patch for post-detok soon. thanks all.
